name: openclaw-line
description: OpenClaw Pipeline Incident Investigator: read-only Airflow failure triage delivered to LINE

scripts.build: npm run build -w @openclaw-line/shared && npm run build -w @openclaw-line/plugin && npm run build -w @openclaw-line/ingestion-worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/plugin --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ingestion-worker --noEmit
